summary: An open-source autopilot for coding directly within VS Code.
description:
An open-source autopilot for coding directly within VS Code.

VS Code integration: Seamlessly extends your IDE. Open-source tool: Modify and extend functionality. Contextual coding: Generates code based on nearby files. Prompting panel: Ask and receive inline answers.

howToUse.title: Install Continue.dev Extension

howToUse.description: Use the built-in panel to ask questions, request code, or get explanations.

howToUse.title: Leverage Contextual Coding
